newsitem.title: USA: BP sells June Cusiana cargo to independent.
newsitem.headline: BP sells June Cusiana cargo to independent.

text.p: British Petroleum sold a cargo of light sweet Colombian Cusiana crude oil Monday for June 21-22 loading, according to market sources.

Accounts of who took the cargo were divided between two different U.S. independent refiners, and the price was pegged at a $1.22 or $1.23 a barrel discount to benchmark July West Texas Intermediate/Cushing on an fob basis, sources said.
Neither BP, nor either of the two potential buyers could be immediately reached to confirm or deny the sale of the crude, which yields relatively high amounts of gasoline.

Traders also said state-owned oil company Ecopetrol sold an end-June cargo of the high-quality Cusiana crude late last week to another independent refiner at a range of $1.20 to $1.23 a barrel discount to July WTI/Cushing.

The placement of the BP and Ecopetrol cargoes takes care of half the June Cusiana loading program, leaving outastanding one more Ecopetrol cargo for June 14-18 loading and one Total cargo for end June-early July loading.
